title: DSNY Staten Island Transfer Station - The tipping floor.jpg

Small DSNY seal on the loader blurred via retouch; workers in the background are tiny and not identifiable. title: Semi-trailer trucks, Rostock Port, 2019 (02).jpg
author: Bahnfrend (Commons user)
notes: Licence verified on the file page: {{self|cc-by-sa-4.0}}. Trucks lined up near the ferry centre of Rostock port (staging lanes) - reads as trucks waiting at a port, not a gate barrier. 26 retouch boxes blur number plates, haulier names on sun visors and grille badges. No modern, openly licensed photo of a queue at a container-terminal gate or grain intake was found on Commons/Openverse.

title: Plant hire depot - geograph.org.uk - 8295380.jpg
author: Bill Harrison (Geograph Britain and Ireland, photo 8295380)
notes: Licence verified on the file page: Geograph import, category CC-BY-SA-2.0 (structured data). Plant-hire depot at Dyce, Aberdeenshire. Channel mix tuned so the yellow machines separate from the concrete; 31 retouch boxes blur the hire company's lettering on booms, counterweights and the telehandler/roller (small manufacturer badges also softened).

title: NACTU inspections at the Port of Baltimore (33740391942).jpg
author: Glenn Fawcett, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP Photography on Flickr)
license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, PD-USGov-DHS-CBP)
notes: Licence verified on the file page: {{PD-USGov-DHS-CBP}}, FlickreviewR passed (United States Government Work). CBP agriculture specialist inspecting an import container (wood-packaging / pest inspection), seen from behind, not identifiable. RETOUCHED RAW: the printed agency lettering on the back of the vest was removed so the frame reads as a neutral inspector, not law enforcement (mesh texture rebuilt from clean vest fabric with scratchpad tool retex_vest.py); assets-src/raw/inspection-proof.jpg is the retouched file, the untouched download is kept as assets-src/raw/inspection-proof.original.jpg. Government photo - no endorsement implied. Rejected: 2023 Baltimore outbound series (POLICE vests, K9, identifiable faces).

title: Mall of Scandinavia November 2015 03.jpg
author: Arild Vågen (Commons user ArildV)
notes: Licence verified on the file page: {{self|cc-by-sa-4.0}} (Wikimedia Sverige technology pool). Crop removes a woman facing the camera at the left edge. Retouch blurs ten faces in the foreground group, on the balcony and on the lower level, plus two small shop signs; distant crowd left as is (not identifiable at output size). Runner-up Trinity Leeds (CC BY 2.0, 2022) is more dynamic but has many identifiable faces and a child near the escalators.
